source: Observed: NWS station observations (api.weather.gov; the ASOS/METAR reports) at KSFO (San Francisco International) and KOAK (Oakland International), kept from each fetch (the API holds about a week). Forecast: NWS gridded forecast MTR/84,107 (quantitative precipitation spread over each period's hours, probability of precipitation, weather intensity and coverage).
note: stations[id].days[date]: base64 of 120 bytes, scripts/rain-days.mjs: 24 local hours' rain (tenths of a mm), then 96 quarter hours' reported wet weather (0 none, 1 light, 2 moderate, 3 heavy); 255 = no report. Within a station's from..to, a date not in days was dry, with every report. forecast[date]: mm (per hour), pop (%), code (intensity as above), likely (1: the coverage says likely or surer), by local hour 0–23.
history: ASOS/METAR archive, Iowa Environmental Mesonet (mesonet.agron.iastate.edu), SFO and OAK, from 2026-11-01: routine and special reports, p01i and wxcodes (scripts/fetch-rain-history.mjs).

climate.note: Per station, by month (0 January): wetDay, the share of days with rain in any hour; wetHour, on those days the share of hours with rain; heavy, of those hours the share heavy (drawn toward the year's share as if 20 more wet hours); spellH, the mean run of wet hours; days, the days counted.
